rule_spec.applied_to: candidate AND null, identically, once per fold
rule_spec.rationale: P33/P35 A12 fallback (registry_append S7_TIER_SUPPORT_v1__A12): treatment enters a fold iff >= 10 training clusters carry |dev_prev| > 0, identically arm and null (ACTIVE_SET_RULE_PREREGISTRATION.json sha256 327fa8ec9fb54e3635ae70b540573b4121c6136fc5034cbdb689cabbe2986db7).

structural_basis.applied_symmetrically: the guard computes one active set per fold and applies it to candidate and null before the parameter-count reconciliation
structural_basis.incapable_of_selecting_on_test_performan: SupportSummary has no target, residual, prediction or metric field
structural_basis.training_fold_support_only: decide() receives a SupportSummary the guard builds from training rows only

seeds.derivation: seed(purpose, fold_id, b) = first 4 bytes of sha256(utf8('{master_seed}|{fold_id}|{purpose}|{b}')) as big-endian unsigned int
seeds.fitting: IRLS is deterministic; no fit-time seed exists
